title: verbesina scandens
intro: Verbesina scandens, commonly known as Climbing Ironweed, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as exhibiting antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Verbesina scandens include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and protect against oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
